task: R18S-3 skeptic (value + feasibility) of the wave/branch slot plan for 28-29 Sep
reason: REFUTED AS WRITTEN. The branch table idea is sound, but the wave schedule cannot be run as written, and its odds are overstated. (1) SLOTS: the limit is 5 per day (CONTEXT l.2351). W1 (3) plus W2 (up to 2, e.g. 'CI only -> exp76b + CI on the division base') already use all 5 on 28 Sep. In branch rows 1-3 that leaves 0 slots for W3 (19:30-23:30Z 28 Sep). R18S-3's own 'keep 1 slot/day for E10' makes the count negative, and PC18-03 already flags 28 Sep as over-subscribed. (2) R8 LADDER CAP: CONTEXT l.2521-2522 and the RESUME l.2605 set the last ladder submit to 29 Sep 02:00Z 'unless the user lifts R8 explicitly'. After that only an emergency repeat is allowed, with a hard edge at 10:00Z. That cap is still listed as a pending user answer. The 12:01Z line ('R8 no longer binds them') is the session's reading of aggressive mode for the 27 Sep 12:00Z mechanism cutoff, not an explicit answer on the 02:00Z cap. W5 (CI files by ~09:30Z, K2-like files by ~11:15Z on 29 Sep) breaks the cap, and 11:15Z also passes the 10:00Z hard edge. A score at ~19:00Z would also leave the user less than 1 h before the 20:00Z tick. (3) DUMMY GAPS: exp73m is slot 3 in branch rows 1-2 but has no place in gpu_dummy_schedule. exp76g is needed in rows 1-2, but lane B runs it only when 45 < U4, so it has no dummy when 45 >= U4 and 46 >= U4. At 15:32Z no experiments/exp76* folder exists, so the 'exp76a NOW ~15:45Z' push has not happened. exp75 has been queued for over 2 h, so '~2 h per dummy per lane' is optimistic for 3 W1 dummies by 23:30Z. (4) ATTRIBUTION MASKING: the LB shows only the team best. A W1 file that is UP over exp70b but finishes after a larger W1 UP stays invisible and reads 'N4', so the plan to 'stack attributable UPs' would wrongly close positive levers in W2. The 20-min stagger fixes ordering: same-family files keep their spacing (43/44, submitted 9 s apart, finished in the same 10-min poll), but it does not fix masking, and the ladder watcher has been off since 07:37Z. (5) VALUE: the plan is public-display only, read on one embryo (~29% of the hidden set). On 27 Sep, 8 rungs gave 1 UP (~9e-5) and 0 crossings. The ~0.55 leans on exp76a at P ~0.45, but scan_recheck RC-A puts coordinject in the float-output class (lab +0.002 -> LB tie twice) with P <= ~0.3. Under the 02:00Z cap there are also fewer readable draws. My centre for P(display >= 0.955 by 19:00Z 29 Sep) is ~0.35-0.45. Private value is ~0, and any finals proposal drawn from ~1e-4 public stack reads is a winner's-curse pick. What is not refuted: W1 itself (2-3 roughly independent levers on the exp70b base, chosen by the 45/46 reads) is within the user's aggressive-mode and Q2 approvals, byte-identical when off and fail-soft per its patches.
fix: Adopt a corrected version, logged in CONTEXT before 00:00Z. (a) SLOT BUDGET per UTC day. 28 Sep: W1 = 3 in rows 1-3, 2 in rows 4-5. W2 gets the remainder, up to 2 files, by ~10:30Z. W3 on 28 Sep only if a slot is left; the E10 hold is released at 12:00Z by the PC18-03 default. 29 Sep: W4 (up to 5) at 00:05Z, all before 02:00Z. W5 happens ONLY if the user explicitly lifts the 29 Sep 02:00Z ladder cap: ask one yes/no line tonight, default = no W5. (b) DUMMIES: either add an exp73m dummy to lane B (rebuild it first and check the drifted builder sha), or replace exp73m in rows 1-2 with exp76a, which is simpler and already in lane B. Push exp76g speculatively right after exp76d, so rows 1-2 are covered whatever 45 reads. Push exp76a now; it is not pushed at 15:32Z. Any W1 file without a COMPLETE dummy by 23:45Z drops to its row's fallback: exp76a, then exp72 as built. (c) MASKING RULE, pre-registered: a W1 file that finishes after another W1 file has shown an UP, and shows no UP itself, reads 'MASKED/unknown', not N4, and its lever is not closed. W2 may then test it on the new best base. Restart run_ladder_watch.sh (300 s) from ~06:30Z 28 Sep so each completion gets its own LB snapshot. (d) Restate the odds as P(display >= 0.955 by 29 Sep 19:00Z) ~0.35-0.45 (0.55 only if W5 is allowed), public-only. Private value ~0: no finals proposal from a stack unless it displays >= 0.955 (the user's class-C (b) rule), never from a sub-display UP.
